pathAssistantSteps.info:
• Select a valid contact via the Assign Contact button if the lead is associated with an existing customer.
  • Link a Circle of Influence (COI) or an accredited Broker if required.
  • Leads can be referred via the dropdown action button from Referrals section (right side of screen).
  • Enter an estimated amount (if required) for Referrals.
  • Log response to close off the Lead.
  • Access Conversation Hub for additional assistance.

• Ensure customer contact details are up to date (update customer contact details via their profile if lead is associated with an existing customer).
  • Set a reasonable follow up date if required (allow max 30 days from today).

• Convert your Lead if applicable.
  • Ensure mandatory fields are completed (i.e. ANZSIC Code, Customer Needs, Notes and Contact information).
  • Validate ABN or ACN to ensure they are active.
  • Select one or more Secondary Customer Needs if customer has multiple needs.
